question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined word and make it meaningful.**

The government has finally agreed to **__wave__** the entertainment tax on the movie.
solution:
The correct answer is "waive."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The word "Wave" means to move your hand from side to side in the air, usually to attract somebody’s attention or as you meet or leave somebody. (हाथ हिलाना (प्रायः किसी का ध्यान आकृष्‍ट करन
